Made up Braintree transactions for the reader tests. No real merchant, card or order.

Field names follow Braintree's Transaction response reference and PayPal's ACP guide, both read 2026-11-21:
https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/reference/response/transaction
https://developer.paypal.com/agent-ready/agentic-commerce-protocol

The two facilitator values in acp-transaction.json ("ChatGPT", "oauth_client_abc123") are the example values printed in the ACP guide. Every other value is invented.
